title: Is this budgeting app worth it?

flags.title: Affiliate link is not disclosed
flags.evidence: You point to "the link in my bio" for a sign-up bonus, but never say you earn a commission.
flags.suggestedFix: Say "I get a commission if you sign up with my link" before you mention the link.

flags.title: Savings are presented as guaranteed
flags.evidence: "You will save at least 500 a year" promises a result that depends on how each person spends.
flags.suggestedFix: Share what you saved and say results vary.

flags.title: Screenshot is cropped above the fees line
flags.evidence: The pricing screen is cut off right above the monthly fee, so the plan looks free.
flags.suggestedFix: Show the full pricing screen or mention the monthly fee out loud.

flags.title: News clip used without credit
flags.evidence: A 6 second clip from a TV segment appears without naming the outlet.
flags.suggestedFix: Add an on-screen credit for the outlet, or replace the clip with your own footage.

flags.title: The app itself is not a bank
flags.evidence: Deposits are held by a partner bank. The app is not FDIC insured, and coverage depends on the partner.
flags.suggestedFix: Say "your money is held at a partner bank" instead of "the app is FDIC insured".

flags.title: Overdraft fee figure was fact-checked before
flags.evidence: A similar figure about average overdraft fees was reviewed by a fact-checker earlier this year.

citation.title: What banks actually charge for overdrafts

flags.suggestedFix: Check the earlier fact check and quote its figure with the source.

flags.title: Not enough evidence for "users save 20%"
flags.evidence: We couldn't find an independent source for this number. It only appears in the app's own ads.
flags.suggestedFix: Attribute it ("the company says") or leave it out.

flags.title: High-yield savings accounts pay more interest than standard ones
flags.evidence: Published rates for high-yield accounts are consistently above the national average for standard savings.
